outcome: diagnosis of admission (jaundice, newborn infection, feeding problems)
cohort: Newborns who were readmitted to a pediatric hospital in the Rhine-Main area, Germany, within the first 28 days of life between 2004 and 2013.
finding: The study found no significant trend in the number of neonatal readmissions per year, and exclusively breastfed newborns experienced fewer feeding problems compared to those with mixed or formula diets.
